title: ClearGenerated Command
description: Delete Forsk-generated solids, opening frames (forsk:kind=opening), and opening markers by forsk:* tags. Optional untagged name-prefix fallback for pre-tag leftovers. Skips layer X-EXIST and forsk:kind=existing even if forsk:generated=1, including when include_untagged_prefixes is true. Default kinds omit drawing and layout, so sheet curves and title-block objects stay unless kinds explicitly includes them. Layout pages are views; clear_layouts removes those.

kinds.description: forsk:kind values to delete. Default wall, floor, roof, opening, opening_marker, room. drawing and layout are not in the default; pass either explicitly to delete those objects.

level.description: Optional forsk:level filter. Omit to match all levels.

dry_run.description: If true, return matching ids without deleting.

include_untagged_prefixes.description: If true, also delete untagged objects whose names start with name_prefixes.

name_prefixes.description: Name prefixes used only when include_untagged_prefixes is true. Default wall-, floor-, roof-, door-, window-, room-.
